prompt: Use case: production-ready 2D game terrain tile strip for Nano Hunter. Create exactly one horizontal 1x3 strip of three adjoining 64x64-style tiles: left end, seamless center with one round Buddhist seal lock, right end. This asset is a heavy solid dash-gate lintel that blocks passage, not a one-way jump platform and not a ramp. Preserve one perfectly horizontal, continuous upper surface and a visibly deep, weight-bearing stone-and-bronze body. Use dark shrine masonry, reinforced bronze straps, restrained moss, muted gold, and a thin cyan ward channel. It must read as sealed architecture and be clearly heavier than the jump platform. Match the Northern and Southern Dynasties Chinese dark-fantasy, ink-teal, shrine-ruin visual language of Nano Hunter. Background must be perfectly flat solid magenta #FF00FF for chroma-key removal. No perspective slope, no diagonal top, no stairs, no floating fragments, no text, no watermark, no shadows outside the object. Canvas 1536x1024; the continuous beam crosses all three equal 512px columns and connects exactly at the column boundaries.
